description: An abstract Angular component class for managing entity forms and actions within the Thingsboard UI, including form state management, entity configuration, and event handling.

classes.name: EntityComponent
classes.description: An abstract base class for entity management components, providing form handling, configuration, and event emission functionalities.

methods.name: onEntityAction
methods.description: Handles entity actions triggered by user events, delegating to configuration or emitting events.

methods.name: updateFormState
methods.description: Enables or disables the entity form based on the edit mode.

methods.name: entityFormValue
methods.description: Returns the current form value after trimming whitespace.

methods.name: prepareFormValue
methods.description: Prepares and trims the form value object.

methods.name: buildForm
methods.description: Abstract method to build the form group for an entity.

methods.name: updateForm
methods.description: Abstract method to update the form with entity data.
